⚖️ A Step Forward in My Legal Journey!

I am pleased to share that I have successfully completed my One-Month Online Legal Internship (October 2026) at Nyaykart Legal.

This internship provided me with valuable practical exposure and an opportunity to strengthen my understanding of various areas of legal practice.

Throughout this journey, I gained insights and hands-on learning in:

• Legal Research and Drafting
• Advocacy-Oriented Practical Learning
• Real Estate and RERA Practice
• High Court Drafting Orientation
• Criminal Law Fundamentals
• Legal Article and Content Writing

The experience helped me understand the practical application of legal concepts, develop analytical skills, and gain a broader perspective on professional legal practice.

I sincerely express my gratitude to Adv. Kartavya Ostwal, Founder of Nyaykart Legal,and the entire team for providing this learning opportunity, guidance, and encouragement.

As I continue my journey as an LL.M. student and aspiring legal professional, I look forward to learning, growing, and contributing meaningfully to the legal field.

Every experience adds a new dimension to the journey of becoming a better legal professional.
